info.title: Physics Anatomy API
info.summary: Accounts, sync, live classes, AI and exports for the Physics Anatomy lab.

post.description:
Delete one class with its students and all their work. Permanent, at once.

The teacher types the class name to confirm, and must have signed in within the last hour.

422.description: The class name does not match

delete.description:
Remove a student and delete everything of theirs: attempts, consents, sessions, benches.

Permanent, at once. Their devices keep their own copy of the work (offline first).

404.description: No such class or student of yours

post.description:
A student deletes their own work and leaves the class. Permanent, at once.

They type their display name to confirm. Their device keeps its own copy (offline first), and
they can join again with the class code, starting fresh.

403.description: Only students leave a class this way

422.description: The display name does not match

post.description:
Delete this teacher's account with their classes, students and all their work. Permanent.

The teacher types their email to confirm, and must have signed in within the last hour.
Start a live class, or return the one already running (so a double click starts one).

get.description: The live board: the running session, every bench in it, and what has been sent.

put.description: Lock steps: students stay on the step they are on until the teacher unlocks.

post.description:
Send one hint to every student whose bench shows this mistake now. Pushing the same
mistake again reaches only those the standing hints have not; if there are none, it returns
the latest hint, so a double click sends one.
An instruction to every student in the class, such as "everyone measure the wire".
A note to one student in the class.
Take back a hint, broadcast or note. Devices hide it if it is still showing.

get.description: Signed out is an answer here, not an error: the reason is `signed-out`.

post.description: The tutor's reply about the current step, streamed. Numbers not from the bench are held.

403.description: AI is off for this class

503.description: AI is switched off or not set up

get.description: The sidebar's numbers, kept small because every page asks for them.

post.description: Turn AI on or off for one class. Undo is the same call the other way.

Replace a student's display name (safeguarding). The student keeps all their work.

The audit entry records that the name was replaced and why, never the old or new name: an old
name flagged as contact details must not be kept anywhere.
Download a table as CSV. Counts and class details only; never student names.

get.description: Liveness check used by the status page and the deploy step.
